title: plugin-dashboard: the objectui#11417 TIE pin's determinism control flakes on CI: the recharts legend draws in one of two identical renders, so "the same rows rendered twice" differs
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named location and a measured reproduction, in a test this lane landed (PR objectui#11433, objectui#11417).

`reach:` a false red that occupied a landing. PR objectui#11458 (objectui#11434 PR 3, which touches only `packages/plugin-designer` and `packages/types`) went red on `Test (shard 4/8)`, job 110807471565, at head `c67e04551`. The single failure was `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.singleSeriesMeasures-11417.test.tsx:255`:

> AssertionError: the same rows rendered twice must give the same markup

The diff of the two markups: in one render `recharts-legend-wrapper` is empty, and in the other it holds the three legend items (`lost`, `open`, `won`). Everything else matched. `main` at `0e9058b95` ran the same shard green, so the control is nondeterministic, not broken.

**Mechanism (the seat's reading; not re-measured):** the test renders each chart type four times through `markupWith` and compares two renders of the same rows as its determinism control (`:249–255`). The recharts legend is drawn asynchronously, after a resize or animation tick, so whether it has landed when `normalisedMarkup(view.container)` is read depends on timing. Under CI load, one of the two reads catches it and the other does not.

**Direction (for the dispatching seat, not a ruling):**
- Make the harness wait for a settled chart before it reads the markup, for example by awaiting the legend's presence or the chart's own ready marker.
- Or normalise the legend wrapper out of the compared markup, if the TIE never depends on the legend. Measure which before choosing.
- ⛔ Don't delete or weaken the control: it is what lets the test read a difference as the data's.
- Pin: run the file repeatedly under load (e.g. `--repeat`), red at BASE, green after.

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`), which landed the test. ⛔ Not graded here; triage grades.
